sentences.text: A retrospective analysis of CT images from four hospitals evaluated a diagnostic system trained on 259 patients and tested on 91 internal and 200 external patients from two equipment manufacturers.
The system employed a convolutional neural network, a type of artificial intelligence, to identify fracture areas, classify types, detect pelvic fractures, and measure fracture line angles.

It correctly classified fractures 95.7% of the time internally and 91.5% externally, with average angle measurement errors of 4.54 and 6.26 degrees, respectively, which were close to specialist errors of 3.64 and 5.18 degrees.
In an exploratory study with six medical readers, residents showed improved sensitivity for detecting non-displaced femoral neck fractures when using the tool, rising from 0.47 to 0.78.
The authors suggest this method could help with diagnosing and preparing for surgery for upper thigh bone fractures.
